- [FACT] User is interested in transportation and parking options in Sandown during the summer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sandown is a small town that can be explored on foot or bike, with several cycle paths and footpaths available.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are regular bus services connecting Sandown to other towns and villages on the Isle of Wight, including Newport, Ryde, and Ventnor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The main bus stop in Sandown is located on the High Street, adjacent to the Co-op.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sandown railway station is located on Station Avenue and connects Sandown to other parts of the island.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are several car parks available throughout Sandown, with the largest located behind the seafront near the pier.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Several taxi firms in Sandown offer transport services throughout the town and the island.
